tools.name: find_vehicle
tools.description: Look up a vehicle by make and model, with an optional year. Returns the engines, transmissions and drive types built that year, how many repair jobs apply, and the factory service manual links.

tools.name: repair_jobs
tools.description: List the repair and maintenance jobs that apply to a vehicle, grouped by section, with a difficulty rank from 1 (easy) to 5 (hardest). Titles only.

tools.name: factory_manual_links
tools.description: Links to industry-leading factory service manuals for a year and make, and whether each one covers that year.

tools.name: recalls
tools.description: Safety recalls for a year, make and model, read live.

tools.name: complaints
tools.description: Owner complaints for a year, make and model: counts by component and the latest few.

tools.name: repair_guides
tools.description: Find our published repair and buyer guides by make, model, year or topic. Returns titles, links and short summaries.

tools.name: mechanic_market
tools.description: Auto repair business counts by trade, shops per 100,000 people and mechanic pay for a US state, or a county in it. From the Census Bureau and the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_access · Private data: get_access, full_manual, my_account · Public sink: get_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_access · Private data: get_access, full_manual, my_account · Public sink: get_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_vehicle" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Look up a vehicle by make and model, with an optional year. Returns the engines, transmissions and drive types built that year, how many repair jobs apply, and the free factory manual archive links." → after: "Look up a vehicle by make and model, with an optional year. Returns the engines, transmissions and drive types built that year, how many repair jobs apply, and the factory service manual links."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
